title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, and she'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Trump says new **Iran** strikes "highly unlikely" if talks progress
items.summary_md: He told CNN further action likely isn't needed but didn't rule it out; Qatar's PM meets him in the Oval Office Monday to push mediation.

items.headline_md: **COP31** climate talks open in Antalya, Türkiye
items.summary_md: The UN climate conference runs Nov 9–20.

items.headline_md: Egypt train collision in Giza kills **7**, injures **112**
items.summary_md: Two trains collided Sunday in Giza governorate, Egypt's health ministry said.

items.headline_md: Houthis claim missile and drone strikes on **Riyadh** airport and Aramco sites
items.summary_md: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh.

items.headline_md: South Africa's **ANC** stays largest party at **30.76%** in local elections
items.summary_md: That's down more than 14 points from 2021; the DA took 24.64% and Zuma's MK 9.76%.

items.headline_md: DR Congo military court sentences **66** soldiers to death
items.summary_md: They were convicted on three counts including cowardice, local media reported.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia** board opens independent probe after reports CEO **Jensen Huang** was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort
items.summary_md: Huang admitted a personal relationship and apologized to staff; House chairs want a closed-door briefing Nov 18.

items.headline_md: **Crédit Agricole** proposes merging its Italian arm with **Banco BPM**
items.summary_md: The deal would create Italy's third-largest bank and lift Crédit Agricole's stake from 29.6% to about 45%.

items.headline_md: Fed's **Musalem** calls inflation the top concern; December hike odds near **77%**
items.summary_md: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee also called inflation the economy's biggest problem after a strong jobs report.

items.headline_md: China's **Huaxin** to buy Brazil's **CSN Cimentos** for **$1.64B**
items.summary_md: It would be China's first entry into Brazil's cement market, pending approvals.

items.headline_md: Poppi founders launch **Jetty** hydration drinks to take on Gatorade
items.summary_md: The self-funded brand sells at Whole Foods, Target and Amazon online.

items.headline_md: Square Enix announces **Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle** for iOS and Android
items.summary_md: More details and the trailer premiere Nov 10.

items.headline_md: Kabam's **WB All-Star Mayhem** idle RPG starts regional testing this month
items.summary_md: 100+ characters from Looney Tunes, DC, Cartoon Network and more; soft launch on iOS and Android in select markets.

items.headline_md: **My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile** opens pre-registration
items.summary_md: A separate mobile battle royale with iOS–Android cross-play but no console/PC cross-play.

items.headline_md: HoYoverse's life sim **Petit Planet** launches Dec 4 on PC and mobile
items.summary_md: It features social spaces and AI-powered NPCs; HoYoverse also showed Honkai: Nexus Anima.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no public repo or release from the r/decomps poster found today (r/decomps itself couldn't be loaded directly this run).

items.headline_md: **NX2navi**: a second native PC recomp of the Switch 2 *Ocarina of Time* remake
items.summary_md: tangerineturtle1's Windows build adds DLSS/DLAA, FSR 3.1 frame gen, HDR, 21:9/32:9 and precompiled shaders; early but playable at 60+ fps.

items.headline_md: **EglantinePS5** fork runs Switch 2 games on jailbroken PS5s
items.summary_md: It boots *Ocarina of Time* and others, but frame rates are poor and crashes frequent.

items.headline_md: **shadPS4** posts a new pre-release build
items.summary_md: Pre-release 3d007aa landed Nov 8 on top of v0.21.0.

items.headline_md: **Dolphin 2609b** released
items.summary_md: A new Dolphin build dropped Nov 8.

items.headline_md: **Xenia** updates to v1.0.2844
items.summary_md: The Xbox 360 emulator shipped a new build in today's Git roundup.

items.headline_md: Update: **Godzilla Minus Zero** now at **$31.6M** for Nov 6–8, a Gkids record
items.summary_md: *The Cat in the Hat* is at $20.5M and *Drummer Boy* $9.3M in Deadline's latest numbers.

items.headline_md: This weekend: **Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol** tracks ~**$22M**
items.summary_md: *How to Rob a Bank* tracks ~$10M and *Victorian Psycho* ~$4M (Nov 13); Sony's *Ghost Soldier* opens Wed at ~$4.4M.

items.headline_md: **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** tracks **$116M** for Nov 20
items.summary_md: Range is $105M–$140M, chasing *Michael*'s $97.2M as Lionsgate's top 2026 debut.

items.headline_md: **Wild Horse Nine** holds **94%** on Rotten Tomatoes
items.summary_md: Martin McDonagh's Sam Rockwell spy film is one of 2026's highest-rated thrillers.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** IPO investors push valuation toward **$1.2–1.3T**
items.summary_md: Reports say buyers are talking down a $1.5T figure; no price range or date has been filed.

items.headline_md: **Google** buys Crusoe's unfinished Wyoming data center site, plans **$17B** build
items.summary_md: Crusoe will still develop another Google campus near Amarillo, Texas.

items.headline_md: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sue **Suno** over AI music clones
items.summary_md: The new suits target AI-generated songs imitating the artists.

items.headline_md: **Palo Alto Networks** in talks to buy AI-agent security startup **Clutch** for **$500M**
items.summary_md: Clutch secures AI agents' access to corporate systems.

items.headline_md: Apple is racing to make **Siri** more agentic
items.summary_md: The Verge reports Apple is pushing Siri toward taking actions in apps for users.

items.headline_md: iOS 27.3 beta hints AI chatbots may come to Apple's **HomeView**
items.summary_md: Code in the beta points to chatbot support in the home app.

items.headline_md: Apple reportedly trims engineers' daily AI-tool budget from **$300** to **$200**
items.summary_md: Bloomberg says deeper cuts are being considered but unconfirmed.

items.headline_md: **Dow futures +538 (1.1%)**, S&P futures +0.7%, Nasdaq 100 +0.4% early Monday
items.summary_md: Lower oil lifted futures ahead of CPI and AI earnings this week (CNBC, early Monday).
Quoted in CNBC's early-Monday update.

items.headline_md: **Nikkei** rebounds **1.7%** after Friday's ~6% drop
items.summary_md: At 58,409 as of 5:27 PM AZ Sunday, led by machinery and financials.
Gold quoted 5:01 AM AZ Monday; Bitcoin early Monday.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: sunny, **83°** / **59°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: No active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: sunny, **62°** / **29°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: No active alerts; a freeze-cold night.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: sunny, **62°** / **29°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: No active alerts.

items.headline_md: Why decomp.dev is shutting down: "The game reverse engineering community is the latest casualty of AI"
items.summary_md: A clear look at how AI-rushed forks and ports are straining the decomp scene behind the recomps you follow.
